manifest.data:
{
    "name": "ClearGo | The Lewis College",
    "short_name": "ClearGo",
    "description": "The Lewis College student clearance portal.",
    "lang": "en",
    "start_url": "./login.php",
    "scope": "./",
    "display": "standalone",
    "background_color": "#f3f8fd",
    "theme_color": "#0b2545",
    "prefer_related_applications": false,
    "icons": [
        { "src": "assets/icons/cleargo-192.png", "sizes": "192x192", "type": "image/png", "purpose": "any" },
        { "src": "assets/icons/cleargo-512.png", "sizes": "512x512", "type": "image/png", "purpose": "any" },
        { "src": "assets/icons/cleargo-maskable-512.png", "sizes": "512x512", "type": "image/png", "purpose": "maskable" }
    ]
}

manifest.description: The Lewis College student clearance portal.
manifest.name: ClearGo | The Lewis College

checks.name: Character encoding is declared before the shared head assets
Service worker controls the login page
Browser reports no installation eligibility errors
Apache serves manifest with its registered content type
Manifest launches the role-aware login within app scope
All declared app icons load at their declared dimensions
Apple touch icon and theme are linked
1280px install card and button fit the screen
390px install card and button fit the screen
320px install card and button fit the screen
Dismissed install prompt is used only once
Installed apps hide the install control
Only public offline page and logo are cached
Offline POST is rejected instead of queued or replaced with cached success
Offline navigation displays the public fallback with resolved paths
Retry recovers to login without a stale authenticated page
